taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: MASVS-PLATFORM; refine the control from the observed boundary

controls.boundary: Android exported components and caller authority — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect the merged release manifest, exported components, permissions, caller checks, intent parameters and URI grants. Record Android/version/build and intended inter-app contract.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned test app/device invoke the component from a separate low-privilege test app with a harmless fixture URI/action. Compare its protected effect with the legitimate app flow and inspect whether identity is checked before privileged work.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An exported component is not inherently vulnerable. A signature permission, caller check or restricted URI grant may enforce the intended contract. A debug manifest may not describe release exposure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply the required caller/action/resource check and narrow component/grant exposure. Retest legitimate integrations, the original untrusted caller and URI grant lifetime where relevant.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
